items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: He played with me. We played all the parades, funerals, and he played in a big band with me.

ctx.x: You know this guy Tats? Yeah. Did you ever work with him or he worked with you?

Yeah, he worked with people a lot of time. When? Oh, a good many years back. He played with me. We played all the parades, funerals, and he played in a big band with me. Played in small jobs, like up here around Broadway and 20 hours, different things, and played a lot of time with me.
What about this guy, Steve Angle?
